Description

If you can’t stop watching Ancient Aliens on History, you already know how much fun a good pyramid mystery can be. Curiosity Stream digs into the same questions with archaeologists and historians, and a Standard Plan lifetime subscription is on sale for $109.97 (reg. $399.99).

Ancient Engineering takes apart how Egypt, Rome, China, and the Middle East built what they built. Pyramid Builders: New Clues, Egypt’s Lost City, and Europe’s Ancient Megasites: Mystery of a Lost Civilization go after the questions that keep you watching past midnight.

All of it comes from the man who started the Discovery Channel. John Hendricks launched Curiosity Stream after founding Discovery Communications, and the service has since won a News & Documentary Emmy. You can watch the whole library in HD on your phone, tablet, Android TV, or Xbox One, or download episodes for a long drive.
